caveats: The four jobs build the original complete workspace with --no-run, then execute the same 50 distinct named selectors each; 200 is repeated executions, not 200 unique tests.

Full Rust test execution and public Host/client-confirmation gates are separate. These local CPU-policy examples explicitly do not certify Host availability, all honest service, budget depletion or production.
Runner ELF SHA and before/after check receipts are consistent; the original ZIPs contain no ELF bytes. Independent ELF digest is null.

Growth is 9 account/history cohorts at 64/1024/16384 accounts and 0/16/128 warmup blocks with fixed three witness owners, 8 measured blocks per cohort, 9 cancelled admissions and 9 cold reopens per lane. It has no p99, wall-time acceptance or throughput qualification and does not replace the original 65536 signed growth gate.

All raw ZIP members are losslessly retained with byte lengths and SHA-256, and independently replayed data readers match the original readbacks. Existing Python reader-controls logs are original hosted evidence, not newly executed tests.
